script: Sea stars have no blood. Instead, they pump seawater through their bodies to move around and breathe. Many can regrow a lost arm. Some can even regrow a whole new body from one arm, if part of the center is attached. To eat, a sea star can push its stomach out of its mouth and digest food outside its body. Most have a simple eye at the tip of each arm. Follow Pixel Abyss for more strange facts from the deep.
